messages:
Eve (Sales): FYI — NovaHealth just surfaced a dedicated capacity ask. They want a pool for embeddings with sustained ~8k qps, ~100k tokens/min, and ability to burst to 20k qps for 3-5 minutes. Asking for SLA + ballpark pricing. Prioritization?

Samir (Product): Thanks. Key questions: 1) Are those qps numbers per region? 2) Is this latency-sensitive (p95 < 150ms) or best-effort? 3) Do they need isolation (dedicated HW) or just reserved capacity?

Eve (Sales): Single region (us-west-2). Latency target p95 <= 200ms. They want tenant isolation (no multi-tenant pools).

Mira (Eng-Runtime): Quick read: sustained 8k qps embeddings with p95 200ms implies large batch throughput and lots of memory for KV cache. Dedicated GPU pools are required. Ballpark GPU count: 10-12 A100-ish equivalents assuming aggressive batching and quantized model. Burst to 20k for a few mins requires autoscaling headroom or burst-only nodes.

Alex (Eng-Infra): Agree with Mira. Two options: (A) over-provision to handle burst (higher monthly cost), or (B) scale with warm standby nodes + fast boot (lower baseline, longer burst latency). For SLA we probably need option A or hybrid with instantaneous fallback to a cheaper model variant.

Jordan (Eng-Platform): Proposed autoscale policy (prototype):

```
policy:
  min_nodes: 12
  target_utilization: 0.65
  max_nodes: 30
  burst_mode: true
  burst_duration_limit: 300s
  cold_boot_pool: 4
```

This gives sustained capacity at min_nodes and ~30 node upper bound for bursts. Need load tests to validate p95.

Samir (Product): Good. From product POV we need launch criteria before committing to SLA: (1) perf run showing p95 <=200ms at sustained 8k qps for 1hr, (2) failover plan if burst > max_nodes, (3) cost estimate and tiered pricing, (4) on-call escalation doc for the pool.

Eve (Sales): Customer also asked about contractual uptime and credits. They want a 99.9% SLA on API availability. Is that realistic for a bespoke pool?

Mira (Eng-Runtime): 99.9% is plausible but depends on redundancy across AZs + automated fallback to hosted model (potentially higher latency). If they insist on single-AZ private deployment, SLA needs to be lower or we add cross-AZ replication (higher cost).

Alex (Eng-Infra): I'll spin up a cost matrix (monthly $) for: single-AZ dedicated (12 nodes), multi-AZ (add 30%), and overprovisioned burst (max_nodes reserved). Will share numbers by EOD.

Samir (Product): For prioritization — this is a clear sales-opportunity but also high implementation cost. Recommend: mark as P1 for enterprise backlog if ACV > $250k/yr. Otherwise P2 auto-queue. Eve, can you confirm expected contract size?

Eve (Sales): Early signals point to $180k–$220k/yr. Could be higher if we include a usage commitment.

Samir (Product): Understood. With that range, propose P2 with a tight technical review and a templated offer: 1) 12-node dedicated pool + burst to 30 nodes for up to 5m/day, 2) 99.5% SLA with cross-AZ optional add-on, 3) performance acceptance test before GA. If revenue increases, bump to P1.

Jordan (Eng-Platform): Action items: @Alex prepare cost table, @Mira outline perf test plan + scripts, @Samir draft acceptance criteria, @Eve clarify contract target timeline. I'll mock the autoscale policy in staging and run a short stress test.

capacity-bot: Created ticket INF-4821 for "NovaHealth dedicated embeddings pool - sizing & SLA review". Link: https://redwood.internal/infra/INF-4821

Eve (Sales): Timeline: customer wants commit within 2 weeks. I'll push for ACV + formal requirements.

Samir (Product): Noted. We'll treat timeline as aggressive — flagging risk: perf unknown, cost sensitivity, SLA mismatch potential. Will update product backlog entry once Alex/Mira numbers arrive.

Alex (Eng-Infra): Cost table uploaded to the ticket. Quick note: keeping 30-node reserved for burst increases monthly by ~42% vs 12-node baseline. Details in INF-4821.

Mira (Eng-Runtime): I'll attach the perf harness + example workload. Initial run tomorrow. If anyone needs the harness earlier ping me.

Samir (Product): Thanks all. Closing loop here — will set acceptance criteria doc in the ticket and schedule a short sync with Sales + Infra tomorrow.

Eve (Sales): :thumbsup:
